name: 402rates.com

overview.text: 402Rates presents tokenized-treasury yield evidence, transfer-cost comparisons and bounded agent-payment tests. The homepage dates its 13-instrument sample to 18 November 2026, not a live quote. Its yield basis uses simple actual/365 annualisation over a 30-day target window, accepting 28-32 days. Measured returns and issuer quotes have separate methods/dates; differences do not prove errors or predict future returns. Paid tools list 0.01 USDC cost comparisons,0.03 yield selection and 5 USDC full instrument evidence, not securities or executed transfers. Paid access is business/professional-only under the terms. Free synthetic tests do not certify general agent safety; the payment ping separately costs 0.001 USDC. Useful multi-instrument answers may include explicit stale gaps and still charge; an entirely unusable selection is refused without settlement. Settlement/server logs alone do not establish delivery. Problems receive manual correction, delivery or repayment review, not unconditional automatic refunds. Internal use/attributed facts differ from redistribution, customer embedding and separately agreed feeds.

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (23:09-23:11 UTC) and one paid research call on 2026-10-31 23:12 UTC (0.001 USDC, micropay test). No deal or contact with 402rates.com or YourAITools is involved.
